## 10 Minutes Readings

Join us at theNCF space on September 19th, 6.30 till 8 pm for **10 Minutes Readings**, a series of short pop-up readings by writers, poets and artist.

This event is kindly sponsored by Mayo Culture Night.

**READERS WANTED!** 

We still have a couple of slots free, if you fancy reading from your own work or something you love on the night, drop a line to: bob@bobjohnstonbooks.com
